senses.gloss: (b. h.; interch. with צָחַק q. v.)to be bright; to laugh, jest, play.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 2:2">Tosef. B. Kam. II, 2</cite> <he>ס׳ בין הבקר וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>צחבין</he>, <he>צהבין</he>, read: <he>צחק בין</he>) if he (the ox) sported among the herd three times (doing no harm).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3">Deut. R. s. 3</cite>, end <he>ראה … שׂוֹחַקַת לעבד</he> the king saw her smile at one of his servants.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:2:4">Y. Kidd. III, 63ᵈ</cite> <he>מימי לא ש׳ וכ׳</he> never did a person have his sport with me, except this man. Tanḥ. Naso 5 <he>באותו שבפנים שָׂחַקְתָּ אבל … לִשְׂחוֹק</he> thou didst fool him (the watchman) that was inside, but thou canst not fool me.
Der. Er. Zuṭṭa ch. V ולא בוכה בין השׂוֹחֲקִים ולא שׂוֹחֵק וכ׳ nor should one weep among those who laugh, nor laugh among those who weep; a. fr.—Trnsf. (of fingers) to be spread, opp. עצב.

<cite ref="Sukkah 7a:3">Succ. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>טפח שוחק</he> (Ms. M. a. Ar. <cite ref="O00001"><he>ס׳</he></cite>); <cite ref="Eruvin 3b:21">Erub. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>שׂוֹחֲקוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="A01989"><he>אַמָּה</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="U00694">same</cite>. Tanḥ. l. c. <he>באישך את מְשַׂחֶקֶת וכ׳</he> thou canst fool thy husband, but thou canst not fool me. Ib. <he>ואני יושב ומְשַׂחֵק על וכ׳</he> but I sit laughing at my creatures.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 9:2">Tosef. Keth. IX, 2</cite> <he>מְסַחֵק הוא בה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מְצַ׳</he>) he may laugh at her (and take the sham sale seriously); (<cite ref="Ketubot 79a:5">Keth. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>רצה מצחק</he>), v. <cite ref="Q00753"><he>פִּיסְטִין</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Noah 5 <he>והיו משחקין ממנו</he> they laughed at him (Noah).
<cite ref="Berakhot 7b">Ber. 7ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>השעה משחקת לו</he> the hour smiles on him, i.e. he is in luck; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to laugh, lead to sport.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>אם בא … להַשְׂחִיקְךָ שמחהו וכ׳</he> if thy inclination comes to incite thee to merriment, rejoice it with words of the Law; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 296">Yalk. Is. 296</cite>.
